title: The Federal Reserve Explained: Who Controls Your Interest Rates
alts: How the Fed Controls Interest Rates (And Your Wallet)
The Fed Was Born on a Fake Duck Hunt. Here's What It Does.
line1: What is the Federal Reserve? 12 people just raised rates to 3.75%-4%, and it hit your card, mortgage and savings. Here's how it works.
summary: Dave's credit card rate goes up and nobody at his bank decided it. We explain what the Fed is, the secret 1910 Jekyll Island meeting disguised as a duck hunt, the federal funds rate and the Sept 2026 hike, how one rate ripples into credit cards, mortgages and savings, the 2022 inflation fight, quantitative easing and the 'money printer' myth, and the balanced debate over Fed independence.
